sloka: प्रतिगृह्य मणिं दिव्यं तव हेतो रघूद्वह ।शिरसा तां प्रणम्यार्यामहमागमने त्वरे ।। ५.६७.३२ ।।।।
transliteration: pratigṛhya maṇiṁ divyaṁ tava heto raghūdvaha ।śirasā tāṁ praṇamyāryāmahamāgamane tvare ।। 5.67.32 ।।।।

translations.english: "as I swelled in size, addressed me, the daughter of Janaka, her face full of tears, piteous, her speech choked with weeping.
